title: incident-bot: attach SLO diagnostics + runbook links to on-call summaries
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: on-call engineers often need immediate context when a PagerDuty alert fires; linking the nearest SLO diagnostic summary and the most relevant runbook(s) directly in incident-bot on-call messages reduces reaction time and churn between tools. Implementation: add a new slo_enricher module that queries slo-toolkit diagnostics API for the alerting service and returns a compact summary (SLO name, burn rate, error budget remaining, top failing endpoints) and runbook URLs; wire enrichment into on-call Slack messages and incident emails; add per-team feature flag (default enabled for sre and platform) and a graceful fallback to the runbook index when diagnostics are unavailable. Tests: unit tests, integration test against slo-toolkit mock server, and fixtures included. Docs: docs/incident-bot/oncall-enrichment.md added. Checklist: [x] module implemented [x] unit tests [x] integration test [x] feature flag + config schema [x] docs updated [x] changelog/release notes added
commits: Add slo_enricher module and initial integration tests
Wire slo enrichment into oncall message renderer and email templates
Add feature flag to team config and default enable for `sre` and `platform`
Add docs and runbook index fallback
Fix linting and test flakiness (retry in integration test)
review_conversation: Connor requested rate-limit handling and graceful degradation for slow diagnostics; author added exponential backoff and 200ms inline timeout with tests. Maria requested clearer telemetry; added incident_bot.slo_enrichment.* counters and updated dashboards. Sean requested email-safe links; added HTML-safe fallback and integration test verification. Minor lint fixes and test retries addressed in follow-up commits.
release_notes: incident-bot: enrich on-call messages with SLO diagnostics and runbook links (configurable per-team). Improves mean time to acknowledge by surfacing context inline.
